idea.title: Ten minutes for one hello
idea.summary: A shy person rehearses a single hello, then finds that with no camera and no face, a nervous stranger is just as awkward and the call goes fine.

scenes.text: POV: you rehearsed one 'hello' for ten minutes before tapping call
scenes.say: Ten minutes, one hello. Every introvert knows this feeling.
Take the face out of it, and it gets way less scary.

scenes.name: Quiet Clown
scenes.say: Tap once, and a stranger picks up.

scenes.name: Quiet Clown

messages.text: Hi! Sorry, I'm really awkward at this
Same. I'm in pyjamas on my third tea

scenes.say: Plot twist: they were nervous too.

scenes.name: Quiet Clown
scenes.label: Pyjamas. Messy hair. Fine.
scenes.say: Nobody sees your room, your hair, or you blushing.

scenes.question: Which is easier for you?
scenes.say: Be honest. Which one would you pick?

post.caption:
No camera. No face. No blushing. Just a hello and a stranger who might be just as nervous as you.
Would you rather say hello on camera or with just your voice?
Try it free to start at randomtalker.com (link in bio).
